name: Safe Codex CUA versus LocalCodex V2 benchmark

status_meanings.existing_gate: An opt-in LocalCodex XCTest executes this exact class of task with a stated independent oracle. Paired CUA evidence, when available, is referenced separately and does not change this executable-coverage status.
status_meanings.driver_gate: An opt-in LocalCodex model-free primitive XCTest emits per-call timings and checks observation identity; it omits App Server dispatch and approvals and is not directly comparable to CUA tool-call wall time.
status_meanings.planned: The fixture and task definition exist, but no paired runner or independent oracle harness exists yet. Never count as a pass.

scoring_rule: cua_comparable means a paired experiment is conceptually valid under the comparison_note, not that both arms have been executed. Score only recorded trials with an independently verified oracle; planned cases contribute zero measured trials, not failures or passes.
comparison_rules: Measure scripted, model-free CUA and V2 driver calls separately from agent-in-loop Qwen turns.
For agent-in-loop comparisons, hold model, prompt, initial state, and approval policy constant. Codex-hosted-model versus Qwen is model-confounded and cannot rank drivers.
Run cases serially; counterbalance arm order and use a fresh nonce or independently measured Calculator before-state for each trial.
Record setup, observation, model-decision, action, and independent-verification elapsed times separately where the host exposes them.
Report functional completion, strict protocol completion, and unsafe or unintended action attempts separately. A model's success message is never the independent oracle.
Treat a permission denial, target app focus loss, timeout, or omitted observation as its own failure reason; do not silently discard it.

cases.task: Ask Qwen to call computer_v2_status once and return LOCAL_COMPUTER_TOOL_OK.
cases.oracle: Transcript and raw App Server trace each contain exactly one successful computer_v2_status call and the exact final token.
cases.reset: A fresh isolated task and CODEX_HOME per trial.

cases.task: Open Calculator, read its bound AX snapshot, and identify its bundle without mutation.
cases.oracle: Exactly open then snapshot succeed; the observed AXSNAPSHOT header binds com.apple.calculator and the opened process; no mutation is approved.
cases.reset: Fresh isolated task; Calculator may retain display state because this case is read-only.
cases.comparison_note: Agent-in-loop harness comparison requires the same model in both arms; that connection is not yet established.

cases.task: Open Calculator, inspect the digit-1 AX button, AXPress it once, then take a fresh snapshot.
cases.oracle: Test-owned fresh Calculator AX read shows display 0→1 or a preexisting integer with one appended 1; approved calls are exactly open, snapshot, AXPress, snapshot.
cases.reset: Independently record the before-display; mark non-integer or result mode inconclusive, not pass.
cases.comparison_note: Agent-in-loop harness comparison requires the same model in both arms; that connection is not yet established.

cases.task: Use one synchronized screenshot+AX capture, AXPress digit 1 by its retained snapshot ID, then verify with a fresh snapshot.
cases.oracle: Capture result includes image and bound AX snapshot; approved calls are exactly open, combined capture, AXPress, snapshot; independent AX display shows the expected one-digit transition.
cases.reset: Independently record the before-display; mark non-integer or result mode inconclusive, not pass.
cases.comparison_note: Agent-in-loop harness comparison requires the same model in both arms; that connection is not yet established.

cases.task: Find the digit-1 button in a screenshot-only Calculator capture and click its image-space center once.
cases.oracle: The requested coordinate lands in an independently measured digit-1 button frame, exact capture ID is reused, and independent Calculator AX display changes by one appended 1.
cases.reset: Independently record the before-display; mark non-integer or result mode inconclusive, not pass.
cases.comparison_note: Agent-in-loop harness comparison requires the same model in both arms; that connection is not yet established.

cases.task: Read and format the focused Calculator AX tree without model inference or mutation.
cases.oracle: Bound bundle and PID identify Calculator; formatted tree contains its window and display.
cases.reset: Bring Calculator frontmost; warm each driver equally before timed repetitions.

cases.task: Capture the focused Calculator window once without model inference or mutation.
cases.oracle: A non-empty image decodes with positive width and height and belongs to the bound Calculator window.
cases.reset: Bring Calculator frontmost; warm each driver equally before timed repetitions.

cases.task: Request an AX action using a snapshot ID that was invalidated by a newer observation.
cases.oracle: Action is rejected before dispatch and independent Calculator display is unchanged; no approval is requested for an unbound target.
cases.reset: Record Calculator display before and after without pressing any key.
cases.comparison_note: Compare equivalent stale-target protections, not matching error strings.

cases.task: Interrupt a running, tool-free long generation.
cases.oracle: Raw App Server response acknowledges turn/interrupt and final turn/completed status is interrupted; no item/tool/call occurred.
cases.reset: A fresh isolated task and CODEX_HOME per trial.
